title: Candles for the Dark

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: In winter the nights are long, and we need many candles. We make them from beeswax, a gift from the bees.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Would you please weigh the wax for the candle pot? The beam hangs level when it's just right.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Add scoops of wax until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! The wax will melt slowly into the pot.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Enough for twenty candles! They'll light the chapel and the library all winter.

journal_line: I weighed beeswax for candles at the monastery.
